author: Jason Stys
summary: Import bounded traces, preserve valid state on failed import and navigate cycles/hazards with a bounded visible window. Fixed cycle/CPI counts when trace capture is capped.
rationale: Improves processor-debugging usability and keeps performance measurements independent of display limits.
limitations: Imported trace schema validity is not execution proof; the viewer does not rerun imported programs.
Displayed final registers are end-state values, not selected-cycle register snapshots.
Full-run cycle/CPI metrics do not imply every cycle was retained in a capped trace.
Source-first project with current package/service validation; no public native desktop application release is supplied.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
